Top Tourist Cities in China

Comprehensive guide to the most beautiful Chinese cities worth visiting – from historic capitals to modern commercial centers

📍 7 Main Cities⏱️ 8 min read📅 Updated 2026
Home◂Tourism in China◂Tourist Cities

China contains hundreds of tourist cities that range from historic grandeur to stunning modernity. Whether you're looking for cultural tourism in Beijing and Xi'an, modern tourism in Shanghai and Hong Kong, or business tourism in Guangzhou, China offers a complete experience in every city. Arcadia Tourism offers customized travel programs covering the most important cities with Arabic-speaking guides and comfortable transportation by high-speed trains.

1. Beijing – The Historic Capital 🏯

Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China and one of the most important cultural and historical centers in the world. It is an essential destination for anyone who wants to discover ancient and modern Chinese civilization. The city contains some of the world's most famous tourist attractions, including the Forbidden City and the Great Wall.

Top Attractions in Beijing

Beijing is famous for world-renowned landmarks such as the Forbidden City (Imperial Palace), the world's largest palace complex, the Great Wall at Mutianyu or Badaling – one of the Seven Wonders of the World. It also contains the Temple of Heaven with its stunning geometric design, the Summer Palace with its gorgeous gardens, and famous Tiananmen Square.

💡 Arcadia Tip

We recommend allocating at least 3–4 days for visiting Beijing. The best times are spring (April–May) and autumn (September–October). You can check China travel tips for more practical information.

2. Shanghai – The Modern City 🌃

Shanghai is China's largest city by population and the most important financial and commercial center in Asia. The city combines the charm of its ancient neighborhoods with the glamour of the future in the Pudong district with its amazing skyscrapers. Shanghai is China's modern gateway and one of the most vibrant cities in the world.

Top Attractions in Shanghai

Among the most important landmarks is the famous Bund with its European-style buildings overlooking the Huangpu River, the iconic Oriental Pearl Tower, and the historic Yuyuan Gardens from the Ming dynasty era. The city also contains the Tianzifang arts and crafts district and Shanghai Disneyland – Asia's largest Disney.

3. Guangzhou – Gateway of Trade and the South 🌺

Guangzhou is located in southern China and is considered its third-largest city. It is a global commercial hub and a favorite destination for Arab businesspeople, especially during the Canton International Fair held twice a year. The city is famous for its world-renowned Cantonese cuisine and diverse tourist attractions.

Top Attractions in Guangzhou

The city's most prominent landmarks include the Canton Tower rising to 600 meters with a stunning panoramic observation platform, the historic Shamian Island with its quiet European atmosphere, and the busy Beijing Road commercial street. The city also features the beautiful Yuexiu Park and Chimelong entertainment resort.

4. Xi'an – Capital of the Silk Road ⚔️

Xi'an is the cradle of Chinese civilization and one of the oldest cities in history. It was the capital for 13 ruling dynasties and the starting point of the famous Silk Road that connected China with the Arab world and Europe. The city is distinguished by its rich Islamic history, with the historic Muslim Quarter and the Great Mosque dating back more than a thousand years.

Top Attractions in Xi'an

The city's most famous attractions include the Terracotta Army – one of the greatest archaeological discoveries of the 20th century, with thousands of life-size soldier statues. The city is also distinguished by its Ancient City Walls, the Drum Tower and Bell Tower in the city center. For halal food lovers, Xi'an's Muslim Quarter is the best destination to taste authentic Chinese halal cuisine.

5. Hong Kong – Pearl of the Orient 🌇

Hong Kong is a vibrant global city that combines East and West in a unique tourist experience. It is famous for its stunning natural harbors, amazing skyscrapers and diverse popular markets. It is considered one of Asia's best cities for shopping and family entertainment.

Top Attractions in Hong Kong

Among the most famous landmarks is Victoria Peak which provides a magnificent panoramic view of the city and harbor, Hong Kong Disneyland, and the Giant Buddha on Lantau Island. The city is also distinguished by its famous night markets such as Temple Street Market and the luxury shopping experience in the Central area.

6. Chengdu – Capital of the Panda 🐼

Chengdu is the capital of Sichuan Province in southwestern China and the top destination for giant panda lovers. The city is distinguished by its relaxed atmosphere and its world-famous spicy Sichuan cuisine. It contains the Giant Panda Breeding Research Base where you can see these rare animals in their natural environment – one of the unique tourist activities only available in China.

7. Guilin – Heaven on Earth 🏔️

Guilin is one of the most beautiful cities in all of Asia. It is famous for its karst mountains that rise amid waters and green fields to create legendary natural scenery. The river cruise on the Li River between Guilin and Yangshuo is ranked among the most beautiful river cruises in the world. For more details on natural scenery, read our guide on Nature in China.
